heroSummary: On the SPS district calendar, students in grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 24, 2026. Kindergarten begins Wednesday, September 2 after screening week, and Pre-K begins Monday, September 14. The tentative last day is Friday, June 25, 2027, with a half-day schedule. That date already includes five snow days and may change if SPS adjusts the school year.

calendarNotes: SPS approved this calendar on March 26, 2026. Teacher workdays run August 17–21, with Convocation on August 21. Grades 1–12 begin August 24; kindergarten screening runs August 24–28 before the September 2 kindergarten opening; Pre-K begins September 14. The PDF distinguishes yellow school closures for students and teachers from green dates when schools and central offices close. November 25 is a schools-closed Thanksgiving Break day, while November 26–27 also close district offices. Holiday Vacation runs December 21–January 5, but January 6 is a teacher professional day, so students return January 7. Presidents' Day leads directly into Mid-Winter Break, and Patriots' Day leads directly into Spring Break. June 25 is a tentative half day that already includes five snow days; SPS says schools close after 180 pupil school days and will confirm the official ending and dismissal by bulletin. The last Pre-K day is the day before the final scheduled last day and will also be confirmed by bulletin.

breaksTitle: Springfield 2026–27 School Vacations and Return Dates

breakNotes.Thanksgiving Break: Schools close November 25; schools and central offices close November 26–27. Students return Monday, November 30.
breakNotes.Holiday Vacation / Winter Break: Vacation runs December 21–January 5. January 6 is a teacher professional day, and students return Thursday, January 7.
breakNotes.Mid-Winter Break: Presidents' Day closes the district February 15 before the February 16–19 school vacation. Students return Monday, February 22.
breakNotes.Spring Break: Patriots' Day closes the district April 19 before the April 20–23 school vacation. Students return Monday, April 26.

customSections.label: Why June 25 Is a Tentative Last Day
customSections.content: June 25 already allows for five snow days and is listed as a tentative last day with a half-day schedule. SPS says schools close after completing 180 pupil school days and will announce the official date and dismissal by bulletin. Families should treat June 25 as tentative until SPS confirms the final date. The Pre-K last day is the day before the final scheduled last day and depends on the same bulletin.

calendarFaqs.q: When is kindergarten screening in Springfield?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten screening runs Monday, August 24 through Friday, August 28, 2026. The first day of school for kindergarten students is Wednesday, September 2. Families should follow their assigned school's screening appointment instructions.

calendarFaqs.q: What does district closed mean on the SPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: A green district-closed date closes schools and central offices. A yellow schools-closed date closes schools for students and teachers but does not identify central offices as closed. The distinction is important during Thanksgiving and school vacations.

calendarFaqs.q: Do SEZP and Innovation schools use this Springfield calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not always. The ICS and main date table summarize the district PDF, while SPS publishes separate SEZP and Innovation School calendar collections. Check the calendar named for your child's assigned school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Springfield calendar list every religious or cultural observance?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district calendar does not list every religious or cultural observance and directs families to the SPS Informational Calendar for a broader list of holidays and celebrations. An observance not printed here is not automatically a school closure.
